messages:
vivian-marketing: Quick sync  small pricing experiment next week. Need final on: FAQ tweak, tier-name variants, calculator routing to SDRs, and webinar subject lines. Short thread.

omar-growth: are we doing staged release? want trials first, then public.

vivian-marketing: yes — trials + in-app message, public blog ~10h later, webinar 72h after public.

lucy-cs: FAQ must show an overage example and dedicated capacity note. Ill draft 2 lines. Also request a Talk to sales button for high-score leads.

raj-product: tier-name variants: Variant 1 = Starter / Growth / Enterprise. Variant 2 = Cost-Saver / Performance / SLA. Expose by ?tier_set=1|2. Keep labels short.

ben-ops: routing plan: calculator returns calc_score 0-100. If calc_score >= 80 post to #sales-pricing with trial_hash + score. Else add to nurture queue. Need param names: utm_src, calc_score, tier_set.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: pricing-calc-v4 -> 2026-07-08T11:00Z. Flags: ?tier_set, ?calc_score.

omar-growth: webinar subject lines to A/B test: A) "Live: Cut token spend with dedicated serving" B) "Webinar: Predictable inference costs at scale". Map A to Variant 2.

vivian-marketing: microcopy tests for hero: A "Estimate monthly inference costs" B "See predictable pricing for production". CTA A/B: "Book a demo" / "Get estimate".

lucy-cs: please include locale in webhook so regional SDRs get routed.

raj-product: tiny impl snippet to persist variant:

``
const s = getParam('tier_set') || localStorage.getItem('tier_set');
if(s) localStorage.setItem('tier_set', s);
``

ben-ops: will add webhook POST /hooks/pricing-lead {trial_hash, calc_score, tier_set, locale}. High-score -> #sales-pricing-high.

vivian-marketing: decision list: 1) soft launch to trials, 2) public blog 10h later, 3) webinar + A/B subject lines, 4) A/B tier names via ?tier_set, 5) routing: calc_score>=80 -> sales-high, else nurture, 6) FAQ microcopy update. If no objections by EOD Ill flip canary. :rocket:

omar-growth: :thumbsup:

lucy-cs: :thumbsup: will drop FAQ copy by 09:00.

vivian-marketing: thanks  will post the checklist and tag owners.
